data.long_meaning: From Persian āyina (آئینہ) 'mirror', borrowed into Urdu as āʾinā. Used as a female given name, often with the poetic sense of clarity and reflection. Aaina therefore means “Mirror; looking-glass”. Persian/Urdu noun āyina 'mirror'; used as a female given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaina expresses “Mirror”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Persian āyina (آئینہ) 'mirror', borrowed into Urdu as āʾinā. Used as a female given name, often with the poetic sense of clarity and reflection.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaina total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.a: Aaina is the Persian and Urdu word for 'mirror' (آئینہ). It is used as a girl's name, often carrying the poetic sense of clarity and reflection.

faq.q: What does the name Aaina mean?
Where does the name Aaina come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aaina?
faq.a: The root of Aaina is Persian āyina (آئینہ).

faq.q: How is Aaina written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aaina is written آئینہ in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aaina a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaina is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aaina appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aaina is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aaina verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Mirror; looking-glass” is established by Persian/Urdu noun āyina 'mirror'; used as a female given name..
